description:
Train a Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier in JASP to predict 'Gender' from the Big Five personality traits. 

Starting with the loaded 'BigFivePersonalityTraits.csv' dataset:
1. Go to Machine Learning > Classification > Support Vector Machine.
2. Set 'Gender' as the Target and all 5 personality traits (Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Neuroticism, Openness) as Predictors.
3. Configure the Data Split: Use a 20% Test set (80% Training).
4. CRITICAL: Enable 'Set seed' and set it to exactly '12345' to ensure reproducibility.
5. Use the RBF Kernel (default).
6. In the Output options, enable 'Confusion Matrix' (for Test set), 'ROC Curve', and 'Performance metrics' (specifically AUC).
7. Save the JASP project as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/SVM_Gender_Analysis.jasp'.
8. Create a text file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/svm_performance_report.txt' and write the Test Set AUC value and the counts of True Positives and True Negatives from the Test Set Confusion Matrix.
